sites.name: IM-1 Odysseus — Malapert A
sites.description: Intuitive Machines' IM-1 Odysseus landed near Malapert A at 80.13 S, 1.44 E on 22 February 2024, the first commercial soft landing. This reference uses a regional 80 m/px LOLA horizon (no 5 m/px near-field DEM) and local IAU 2000 ephemerides. IM-1 lies near the northern edge of the 80S DEM: equatorward samples beyond the DEM boundary are unavailable, so distant relief may be underrepresented to the north.

citations.label: NASA LRO — Images of Intuitive Machines' Odysseus lander
NASA PGDA — LOLA 80S 80 m/px regional DEM

sites.name: IM-2 Athena — Mons Mouton
sites.description: Intuitive Machines' IM-2 Athena landed in the Mons Mouton region at 84.7906 S, 29.1957 E on 6 March 2025 and came to rest on its side. This reference uses a regional 80 m/px LOLA horizon and local IAU 2000 ephemerides.

sites.name: Blue Ghost 1 — Mare Crisium
sites.description: Firefly's Blue Ghost Mission 1 landed near Mons Latreille in Mare Crisium (18.56 N, 61.81 E) on 2 March 2025. This reference uses an analytic flat horizon and local IAU 2000 ephemerides; it is not a LOLA terrain analysis.

citations.label: NASA — Firefly Blue Ghost lands on the Moon

sites.name: IM-3 Reiner Gamma — target
sites.description: Intuitive Machines' IM-3 (PRISM) is a future CLPS target in the Reiner Gamma region (representative point 7.5 N, 59.0 W). This reference uses an analytic flat horizon and local IAU 2000 ephemerides; the site is not yet occupied.
